# valid_signature: # The reference netcode 1.02 decision for the equivalent token, from the
# pinned mas-bandwidth/netcode source. Column order:
#   case id <TAB> description <TAB> netcode reference decision
# "accept" is a full admission; "refuse:<class>" is a refusal with the reason
# class netcode 1.02 names. The rocketnet decision is computed live by the
# harness; only the netcode reference column is recorded here.
# replayed_token: netcode 1.02 binds a token to a server address and an
# expiry and stops there -- a token is transferable for its whole lifetime,
# so a replay is admitted (accept). rocketnet adds used-token history and an
# admitted set, so it refuses the replay. That is the one expected
# "rocketnet-stricter" line, and it is within REQUIREMENTS.md ("no security
# property weaker than netcode 1.02" -- stricter is permitted).
valid_signature
<tab-separated description>: connect token with a valid signature

# valid_signature: expired_token
bad_signature
wrong_server_address
<tab-separated description>: token names a server address this server is not advertised at

# valid_signature: replayed_token
<tab-separated description>: a token already admitted, presented again from another address

# valid_signature: full_server
wrong_protocol_id
<tab-separated description>: protocol id does not match the server's

# valid_signature: timeout_out_of_range
<tab-separated description>: timeout seconds zero (or out of range)
